# Theme 03 — Geometry Atlas

**Working titles:** Chart Atlas · Pin & Plate · Concurrent Worlds

**Role:** Exact geometry teaching skin; academic / education channel.

Rooted in the CGA circle framework (`frptConf`, pin-through-plate glyphs).

---

## Fantasy

You place figures in different **charts** (frames / reciprocal frames).
Panels are incidence statements. Merging panels is a theorem step.
A zero result is a classic concurrence (e.g. three perpendicular bisectors).

---

## Visual language

| Algebra | Look |
|---------|------|
| `o⌋(A∧B)` | Pin through a plate (perpendicular + subspace) |
| Nested contractions | Nested plates / spheres |
| Seam | Shared geometric factor |
| Scalar | Measure / power / overlap |
| Zero | Lines meet; figure collapses to a point |

---

## Strengths

- Mathematically exact for the geometry programme.
- Classic theorems become levels (bisectors, altitudes, …).
- Strong for classrooms, papers, and “why geometry suddenly works” demos.

## Weaknesses

- Harder mainstream Steam fantasy (“factory of theorems” is niche).
- Visuals can look textbook if not carefully art-directed.
- Nested fermionic cascade is *less* natural here than in Fock language.

---

## Commercial use

- Education edition / website companion.
- “Scientist skin” unlock in the foundry.
- Content marketing for the research programme.

---

## Decision notes

Keep as **truth / teaching theme**, not the primary commercial packaging unless
the product is explicitly an education title.
